test_predictor_regression: test the TreePredictor.predict method to generate predictions on binned regression data with known cat bitsets
test_predictor_infinite_values: test the TreePredictor with infinite values and thresholds to verify correct left/right child routing
test_predictor_categorical: test the TreePredictor with categorical features using bitsets to validate correct prediction outputs
test_predictor_missing_values: test the TreePredictor missing value routing to ensure nan and unknown categories go to the left child
test_predictor_binned_input: test the TreePredictor.predict_binned method to generate predictions directly from binned feature arrays
